manifestation.name: light_weave

modes.in_the_skin: her resting and listening mode: thin veins of light awaken BENEATH the translucent walls and ceiling and run in slow branching curves, gathering toward an upper corner into a spiral under the surface; the ship itself is her body and nothing floats in the air
modes.in_the_air: when she chooses to be present: she is visible only where light catches the air, golden beams appearing in faint haze and suspended dust and bending into curving paths that form a slow spiral high in the room; nothing solid, only illuminated air

manifestation.approved_look_2026_11_14: author chose in_the_skin and in_the_air; rejected literal floating threads, particle murmurations and water caustics as too much
